response.rationale: Booking is handled by BookingService and BookingRepository: it is linked to individual memberships (findActiveByMembership) and checks hire stock. ClubBooking has its own repository (Map<string, ClubBooking>) and service, with invoicing, and SessionService.effectiveCapacity reads it, so club bookings appear to hold back session capacity. Separate storage, services and behaviour point to two related but different concepts: individual bookings and club or group block bookings. This rests mainly on graph method and class names, since only one line of code from each class was visible.
